name: Support member permissions policy example
answer:
Workspace owners can change a member's role from workspace settings.
Workspace owners can grant administrator access within 24 hours.
Support can add unlimited administrators on request.

sources.title: Support Member Permissions Policy
sources.content:
Workspace owners can change a member's role from workspace settings.
Workspace owners can grant administrator access within 7 days.
Support can help with role changes after confirming owner approval.
